input.summary: Web cart_to_checkout_rate at 2026-11-27T01:00 was 0.667 against an expected 0.833 (delta -0.167, z -10). The data is complete, so the drop is real. Both web countries are down: DE carries about 73% of the delta and FR about 27%. Almost all of it is lower conversion rather than a change in country mix (rate -0.164, mix -0.006). The drop is limited to web. iOS is +0.7% and Android +15.1%, and iOS is also flat within DE (+6.3%) and FR (-2.0%). This rules out seasonality and the two country-scoped search releases at 00:00 (search-ranker v7.2 in DE, search-ui v3.0 in FR), which would also have hit apps. Web client_error_rate is at baseline (z -0.19), so that causal edge is refuted. The only web-specific change found is the planned checkout-web release at 2026-11-26T10:00. That release declared no expected effect and came 14h before the first change at 2026-11-27T00:00. No specialists were available, so the cause can't be confirmed.
